questions.explanation: 'Wish' about present ability takes 'could'.
An unreal present wish uses 'were' for all persons.
'Suppose' for a hypothetical suggestion takes the past simple.

options: I'd rather you don't tell anyone.
I'd rather you didn't tell anyone.
I'd rather you wouldn't tell anyone.
I'd rather you not tell anyone.
questions.explanation: 'Would rather' about others takes the past simple.

questions.q: It's time you ___ up — it's 8 o'clock!
questions.explanation: 'It's time' takes the past simple for present meaning.

questions.q: She acts as if she ___ the boss.
questions.explanation: 'As if' for an unreal situation takes 'were'.

options: He talks as though he knew everything.
He talks as though he knows everything.
He talks as though he would know everything.
He talks as though he had known everything.
questions.explanation: 'As though' for an unreal comparison takes the past simple.
'Wish + would' complains about an annoying present situation.
'If only' about the present takes the past simple.

questions.q: Suppose she ___ — what would you do?
questions.explanation: 'Suppose' for a hypothetical scenario takes the past simple.

options: I wish you will listen to me.
I wish you listen to me.
I wish you would listen to me.
I wish you would listened to me.
questions.explanation: 'Wish + would' expresses annoyance at someone's behaviour.
An unreal present wish takes 'were'.
'What if' for a suggestion takes the past simple.

options: She behaves as if nothing happened.
She behaves as if nothing has happened.
She behaves as if nothing had happened.
She behaves as if nothing would have happened.
questions.explanation: 'As if' about an earlier past event takes the past perfect.
'Would rather' with a different subject takes the past simple.
'It's high time' takes the past simple.

options: Suppose he misses the flight — then what?
Suppose he missed the flight — then what?
Suppose he would miss the flight — then what?
Suppose he had missed the flight — then what?
questions.explanation: 'Suppose' for a hypothetical situation takes the past simple.
'Wish + wouldn't' complains about a habit.

questions.q: He looks as if he ___ a ghost.
questions.explanation: 'As if' about an earlier past moment takes the past perfect.

options: If only they will stop arguing!
If only they would stop arguing!
If only they would stopped arguing!
questions.explanation: 'If only + would' expresses annoyance at a present situation.
